```yaml
name: Version Uploads

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '*'
    branches-ignore:
      - main

jobs:
  upload-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Sentry CLI
        run: npm install -g @sentry/cli

      - name: Upload version to Sentry
        env:
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: |
          RELEASE=${{ github.sha }}
          echo "Creating Sentry release $RELEASE"
          sentry-cli releases new $RELEASE
          sentry-cli releases set-commits $RELEASE --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          # Upload source maps if a dist folder exists
          if [ -d "dist" ]; then
            echo "Uploading source maps from dist/"
            sentry-cli releases files $RELEASE upload-sourcemaps ./dist
          fi
          sentry-cli releases finalize $RELEASE
          echo "Sentry release $RELEASE finalized"
```
